use_case: Generative AI assistant integrated in the CUI suite (SYS-01): search and summarize customer specifications and drawing notes, draft setup sheet text, inspection plan outlines, and first article report narratives
vendor_or_model: CUI suite provider's integrated generative AI assistant (large language model add-on to SYS-01)
source_evidence: EV-043 (CNC Programmer asked for an approved tool); EV-055 (provider documentation review); EV-056 (pre-deployment test)
data_categories: CUI: controlled technical information, including ITAR and EAR technical data, in prompts, retrieved files, and outputs
consequential_decision_category: None directly; Safety/CI if outputs were used for dimensions, tolerances, NC programs, or inspection criteria (prohibited)
human_in_the_loop: The CNC Programmer or Quality Inspector checks every output against the source document; numbers are copied only from the source; first article inspection unchanged
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7012(b)(2)(ii)(D) (FedRAMP Moderate-equivalent cloud); CMMC scoping 32 CFR 170.19(c) (CUI Asset); ITAR 22 CFR 120.56 and 120.54(a)(5); EAR 15 CFR 734.18(a)(5); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: Proposed; approved with conditions for a 2-user pilot, not before 2027-04-01
